0022600107.text: The Houston Rockets (2-0) visit the Atlanta Hawks (2-0) for the third game of the Rockets' season, with both teams unbeaten so far. Houston is 1st in the Southwest and 3rd in the West, while Atlanta is 1st in the Southeast and 1st in the East. Houston is missing Fred VanVleet (knee) and Steven Adams (ankle), who are both out, and Reed Sheppard (knee bruise) is day-to-day and a game-time decision, while Atlanta is without Henri Veesaar (knee) and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture), who are both out.
